top_signals.title: North Sea Oil Plunge Deepens as Traders Weigh Iran De-Escalation
top_signals.summary: North Sea oil prices slumped to fresh lows on Wednesday as the region’s physical crude traders weighed the prospects of a de-escalation of the Iran war following US President Donald Trump’s heavy defeat in the midterm elections.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Weekly Vessel Valuations Report, November 3 2026
top_signals.summary: Bulkers Supramax values firmed at the younger end of the curve, with Kristinita and Charade both selling at premiums to VV Value amid positive Asian sentiment and tight prompt tonnage. Capesize values edged higher as the earnings rally gathered pace, with Cape Alliance selling well above VV Value. Panamax and Handysize values drifted marginally lower ...
